commands.name: ccu
commands.description: Commands for working with a HomeMatic CCU

commands.name: backup
commands.description: Create a firmware backup of a configured CCU

commands.name: events
commands.description:
Subscribe to the events of a CCU and print them until Ctrl+C, Q or Esc is
pressed
Syntax:
ccu events [<Name>] [options]

options.name: --callback-host
options.description:
Host/IP the CCU uses to reach this machine (default:
auto)

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Name of the configured CCU connection

commands.name: add
commands.description:
Add a new CCU connection
Syntax:
connection add [<Url>] [options]

commands.name: list
commands.description:
List all available CCU connections
Syntax:
connection list [options]

commands.name: remove
commands.description:
Remove a CCU connection
Syntax:
connection remove [<Url>] [options]

commands.name: details
commands.description:
Show details for a device
Syntax:
device details [<Address>] [options]

options.name: --skip-service-params
options.description:
Skip the SERVICE ParamSet. It is not loaded from
the CCU and overrides a SERVICE entry in

commands.name: export
commands.description:
Export device to json file
Syntax:
device export [<Address>] [options]

options.name: --skip-service-params
options.description:
Skip the SERVICE ParamSet. It is not loaded from
the CCU and is not written to the export file

commands.name: list
commands.description:
List all devices for all CCUs
Syntax:
device list [<FilterPattern>] [options]
